mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO biz_prompt_comment( comment_id, prompt_id, comment_content, remark, version, del_flag, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, tenant_id ) VALUES
( #{item.commentId}, #{item.promptId}, #{item.commentContent}, #{item.remark}, 0, 0, #{item.createDept}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.tenantId} )
mapper.select: SELECT t1.comment_id, t1.prompt_id, t1.comment_content, t1.remark, t1.version, t1.create_dept, t1.create_by, t1.create_time, t1.update_by, t1.update_time, t1.tenant_id FROM biz_prompt_comment t1 LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_comment_complete t2 ON t1.comment_id = t2.comment_id AND t2.media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId} LEFT JOIN biz_prompt_template t3 ON t1.prompt_id = t3.prompt_id WHERE t1.del_flag = '0' AND t2.comment_complete_id IS NULL AND t3.template_type = #{platform} LIMIT 100
